title: How should identifiers widen without breaking old references?
question: How should identifiers widen without breaking old references?
answer:
E-8: Touch-and-update, locked 'for the whole update'. New WBIDs are uppercase width 4; existing IDs widen only when their record is next touched (move-spec/move-task, former ID kept); the allocator treats S-00Q and S-000Q as the same; completed records are not renamed. 'We can do the sweep during the QA/verify, and find what we missed.'
E-6: Two new v4 build Specs added to S-00O's build list, not folded into S-00P. Final order ('Yes, lets do it'): (1) WBID Spec (uppercase width 4 allocator, dual-form lookup, ADR-0041 amendment); (2) board Spec (TASKBOARD.json, lanes, lane function, sitrep; ADR-000E and ADR-0013 amendments); (3) S-00P TK-002..TK-005 rewriting controls once around the new board; (4) S-00O release.
